0022600007.text: The Thunder (1-0, on a one-game win streak after a road win) are 2nd in the Northwest and 6th in the West as they host the Denver Nuggets, who have yet to play a 2026-27 game. Oklahoma City is without Nikola Topic (back surgery), Otega Oweh (Achilles surgery) and Thomas Sorber (knee surgery), while Denver is missing Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring). The teams have not met yet this season, and the Thunder won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, though Denver beat Oklahoma City 127-107 in their last meeting in Denver on April 10, 2026.
